summary: End-to-end verification of the new Product Name Sanity feature — 12/12 backend pytest cases pass and all critical frontend flows work as specified. Auth guards, report shape, supplier + issue filters, single-row apply w/ restore, Pydantic validation (empty / <3 chars / >250 chars all return 422), and bulk apply-suggested with samples[] all confirmed. Audit logs verified directly in MongoDB: RENAME_BULK and RENAME_AUTO entries written to audit_logs with user_email='admin@test.com'. Frontend: sidebar link 'Name Sanity' present with ShieldCheck icon in the correct position within Products & Suppliers (after Tools Manager, before Price Tickets). Stats resolve (scanned=238, flagged=200). All pns-* testids resolve. Skip decrements the flagged counter and removes the row locally. Inline edit correctly disables Apply when empty and enables when the value differs from current name. Auto-fix all button visible + enabled. Supplier + issue filter dropdowns populated and Apply reloads.
critical_code_review_comments: In the preview DB, ALL 200 flagged rows report supplier='unknown' — the supplier field is missing/null on flagged docs. Not a code bug, but supplier filter is effectively useless right now. Main agent may want to seed richer data OR the supplier field on supplier_products needs backfilling.
Report scanner uses a hard cap of min(limit*5, 8000). With limit=5000 and DB growth beyond 8000 rows this may under-report. Acceptable for now but worth a scan-in-batches follow-up.

apply-suggested writes updated_at + product_name_fixed_by + product_name_fixed_at to supplier_products but does NOT mirror to the tiles collection (the single-row /apply DOES mirror). Inconsistency — bulk auto-fix leaves the tiles collection stale.
AdminDashboard (unrelated) emits a React 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' warning — pre-existing regression, not in-scope for this feature.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests use existing flagged rows from preview DB. Any renames were restored to original names within the same test. TEST_Sanity_<hex> transient values may briefly appear in audit trail but not in supplier_products post-restore.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature ships clean. Preview DB has 238 supplier_products of which 200 are flagged (dominated by missing_size — DB pollution from stale seed data, not a scanner bug). If retesting, note that supplier_counts contains a single 'unknown' bucket — this is data, not a defect. Audit records live in the audit_logs collection (not audit_log). log_audit signature: pass user=current_user (not user_email=...).
rca of the issue: N/A — no defect found. Feature verified working.
